versions.summary_plain: Three takes on the one screen of the habit tracker, each with the same real content: today's habits, one-tap ticking, current and longest streaks, and a 6-month heatmap. Ticking works and updates streaks instantly. The habits and their history are generated in memory, so a reload resets them; saving to IndexedDB and export/import are not built yet.
what_is_real: Preact + Vite app, really running; layout, components and colours are the app's
Streak maths (current and longest) and the 6-month heatmap are computed from the tick data, using local-date keys so months, leap years and time zones cannot shift a day
Ticking a habit is one tap and updates the row, the streak and the heatmap immediately
what_is_faked: Habits and ~200 days of history are generated in memory; nothing is stored, so a reload resets everything (the real build uses IndexedDB)
The tab switcher in the header only exists to compare the three directions; the real app ships one
New habit / Reorder / Edit / Export JSON / Import are buttons that do nothing yet
Archiving habits and renaming/recolouring are not drawn; they stay in scope
No offline/PWA manifest yet, although the app already has no backend
versions.how_to_run: cd web && npm install && npm run dev, then open http://localhost:5173 (add ?d=grid or ?d=cards for the other directions)

scope.reason: One screen plus habit editing, an IndexedDB store with export/import, and unit tests for the streak and calendar logic. New project, no existing data or system to break.

directions.title: Today list
directions.idea: Today first: a progress bar and five large tap rows, each with a 7-day spark and its streaks. A 'yesterday catch-up' block covers past days, and one heatmap sits at the bottom for the selected habit.
no_longer_shown: Only one habit's heatmap is on the page; the others need a tap to reach

directions.title: Week grid
directions.idea: Habits as rows, the last 7 days as columns: the whole week is tickable at a glance, with current/longest streaks in the last column and the selected habit's 6-month heatmap underneath.
no_longer_shown: Smaller tap targets than the other two, and on the phone the table scrolls sideways so the last days and the streak column are off-screen

directions.title: Habit cards
directions.idea: A card per habit holding everything about it: the tick for today, current/longest/last-30-days numbers and its own 6-month heatmap, two across on desktop and one per row on the phone.
no_longer_shown: No single list of today's habits and no overall day progress; checking the day off means going card by card
No way to tick a past day from this screen
